subject: SIG intake — SSO assertion samples, SCIM reconciliation steps & EU residency notes
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@apexhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — SSO assertion samples, SCIM reconciliation steps & EU residency notes

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the SIG intake call this morning. Per Apex Health's request we want to provide the SIG team with a concise package focused on access control: SSO/SAML assertion examples, a recent SCIM delta sample, and a short narrative around how we handle entitlements for EU-hosted tenants (data residency + audit traceability).

Can you confirm the specific evidence items SIG asked for? On our side we can produce:
- an anonymized SAML assertion sample (with standard attributes we send: email, name, role, tenant_id)
- a 48-hour SCIM delta snapshot showing adds/updates/removes for a test tenant
- an access ownership matrix export (service accounts and delegated roles)
- a short note on data residency and where session/assertion logs are retained for EU customers

If that matches what you need, we'll prepare attachments and a brief cover note. Targeting end-of-day PT (today) to hand off the package — does that timeline work for your SIG reviewer?

Thanks,
Jonas
---
Jonas Weber
Senior Security PM, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

(attachments: saml-assertion-sample.xml stub, scim-delta-snapshot.csv stub)

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@apexhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Ops <security_ops@apexhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 12:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SSO assertion samples, SCIM reconciliation steps & EU residency notes

Hi Jonas,

Appreciate the quick follow-up. The SIG reviewer asked for the following specifically:
1) One or two SAML assertion examples — one for a normal user login, one for a federated service account (showing differences in attributes).
2) SCIM delta showing a small window (we prefer 24–72 hours) with at least one add, one update, and one remove — include timestamps and actor if available.
3) A short explanation of role-to-permission mapping (how roles in the IdP map to Redwood RBAC) and an example mapping for a healthcare customer.
4) Clarify whether assertion/session logs for EU tenants are retained within the EU region or replicated to US for analysis; if replicated, what protections are in place.

EOD PT is OK, but the reviewer prefers the package to indicate which fields are redacted / anonymized so they can validate completeness without seeing PII. Also, can you flag any service accounts that require elevated access so we can review least-privilege mappings?

Thanks — I'll loop in Security Ops if we need a signed attestation.

Best,
Elena Rodriguez
Senior Compliance Manager
Apex Health
elena@apexhealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SSO assertion samples, SCIM reconciliation steps & EU residency notes

Folks,

Per Elena's reply, here are the action items I propose (short, actionable):
1) Jonas — produce two SAML assertion samples, label fields redacted_vs_sample, and include one for a federated service account. Attach filename: saml-assertion-sample.xml.
2) Priyom — generate a SCIM delta snapshot (24–48 hours) with a minimal PII redaction plan. Filename: scim-delta-snapshot.csv. Include actor ids where possible but replace emails with hashed identifiers.
3) Marcus — prepare a one-page mapping doc (bullet list) that shows IdP role -> Redwood role -> permissions; highlight service accounts that grant admin-level scopes. Filename: access-ownership-matrix.xlsx
4) I'll draft the cover note explaining EU residency: where logs are stored, retention windows, and replication behavior. We will explicitly state which logs are region-local and what encryption/contractual controls apply.

Timeline: assemble drafts by 15:00 PT, internal review 15:00–15:30, final package to Elena by 15:45. If any blocker, call me.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Engineering (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

All — attaching the artifacts for internal review (stubs attached below). Notes:
- scim-delta-snapshot.csv -> contains three events (add/update/remove) for tenant_id=eu-4812; emails replaced by uid_hash_*. Timestamps in UTC.
- saml-assertion-sample.xml -> two assertions included; the federated service account assertion includes an attribute aws_assume_role arn-like value to illustrate cross-account role exchange.
- access-ownership-matrix.xlsx -> CSV tab included in the package showing mapping. Callouts: service_account_readonly and service_account_admin are included; Marcus please highlight admin-level ones for Laura's note.
